newsitem.title: USA: Kmart completes sale of Mexican operations.
newsitem.headline: Kmart completes sale of Mexican operations.

text.p: Giant retailer Kmart Corp said it completed sale of its equally-owned joint venture company, Kmart Mexico S.A. de C.V., to Controladora Comercial Mexicana S.A. de C.V..
Kmart will receive about $90 million in cash and tax benefits for its 50 percent ownership interest in the venture.

"The sale of Kmart Mexico is consistent with our commitment to improve our overall financial performance by focusing on the core business - our traditional Kmart stores and Super Kmart centers," said Floyd Hall, Kmart chief executive, in a statement.
Kmart operates 2,134 Kmart stores and 168 Builders Square outlets.
